Game Masters, or GMs, are Blizzard employees who oversee World of Warcraft and watch over a server to solve problems, disputes, and sometimes punish people disobeying the Terms of Use policy Blizzard set forth. Players can create an in-game petition (usually called a "ticket") to alert the GMs of certain problems they are experiencing. GMs are reactive in their response to problems, and as a result won't take action until a ticket has been filed and they have been informed about the issue. The issue must be one they can assist with and they must be able to verify that action is required, which is done entirely via internal logs. Galakrond's Rest is a massive boneyard, located in the Dragon Wastes of the Dragonblight. The skeleton that's half-emerged from the ice is far larger than any dragon that's darkened the skies of Azeroth in living memory. Those are the bones of Galakrond, a massive proto-dragon known as the "progenitor of dragonkind", and this is the place he fell at his death. During the war against the Lich King, the Scourge and the Cult of the Damned tried to dig Galakrond up and raise him as a frost wyrm, but they were driven away before they could manage it.

A game demo (also called shareware or trialware) is a version of a game that is limited in some way (lower level cap, time limited, reduced features, etc.) but otherwise gives a player a first impression of the full game. A game demo is an often, but not always, freely distributed demonstration or preview of an upcoming or recently released computer or video game. Game demos of Warcraft: Orcs & Humans, Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness and Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos have been released. Warcraft II and III do not have game demos of their expansions; Warcraft I never had an expansion. World of Warcraft formerly had a trial version of its own which was replaced by the World of Warcraft Starter E

Galen's Fall was a Forsaken camp along Thoradin's Wall near the entrance into the Hillsbrad Foothills from the Arathi Highlands.
Gallow's End Gauntlets are a quest reward from Holland's Experiment.

The Gallywix Rocketway Exchange is a station of the Bilgewater Cartel Rocketway, located near the Gallywix Pleasure Palace. The Rocket-jockey will greet successful arrivals with, "Welcome to the Gallywix Rocketway Exchange! Debts to pay or get the heck away."
Gally Lumpstain is a goblin of the Argent Dawn and a prisoner of the death knights in the Scarlet Enclave.
Gail Nozzywig is a goblin quest giver found in Razor Hill in Durotar.

Gallywix Labor Mine is a kaja'mite mine built into the volcano on the Lost Isles. The entrance is at Sky Falls. It's here the Trade Prince brought all the goblins he captured from Town-In-A-Box while the volcano was erupting. The trade prince, using Blastshadow the Brutemaster and his Brute Overseers, makes sure the goblins mine the kaja'mite, even though the volcano is erupting.

Galerek's Remorse is a Horde ship floating on the surface above the Shimmering Expanse in Vashj'ir. It is one of three Horde ships in the area searching for survivors of the ships that are wrecked at the start of the Vashj'ir storyline.

These are alternative ways to play World of Warcraft which are supported very little, if at all, by the game itself. For the most part, they represent variations created by players with self-enforced rules. Rule often work well in conjunction with others. They work best when combined with a coherent role-playing narrative.
Gang War is a quest achievement earned for winning a duel in Sethria's Roost whiling on the The Protectors of Hyjal quest. Requirement for the meta-achievement Veteran of the Molten Front.
Gan'zulah's Body drops from Gan'zulah in Northern Stranglethorn.
Gamella Cracklefizz is a goblin quest giver located near the ramp to Eastwall Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Galra is a Horde heirloom vendor in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Councilor Arial D'Anastasis‎.
Gammoth Tenders are snobolds located at Gammoth in the Borean Tundra.

Gai Lan is a pandaren farmer who lives in the Valley of the Four Winds. His farm is constantly plagued by massive weeds which he deals with by using weed killer. He also appeared at the Celestial Court on the Timeless Isle.
Galus' Chamber is a room at the end of the southern wing of the Cursed Depths where Archmage Galus resides.
Galleon is part of Salyis's Warband, a world boss introduced in World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria.

The Gai-Cho Battlefield lies between Fire Camp Gai-Cho and Kri'vess in northern Townlong Steppes. A great many Gai-Cho gatewatchers, boltshooters, and cauterizers are defending the path up to the fire camp, but the yaungol are beset by Kri'thik swarm mantid in the form of Kri'thik aggressors and elite screechers.

__NOTOC__ Gaivan Shadewalker is a night elf quest giver patrolling the entrance to the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale. He is part of the Druids of the Claw. He would like the adventurer to take care of a few druids who turned insane.

__NOTOC__ Gai-Cho Pitchthrowers are yaungol located at Fire Camp Gai-Cho in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Gai-Cho Earthtalkers are yaungol located at Fire Camp Gai-Cho in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Gai-Cho Boltshooters are yaungol located at the Gai-Cho Battlefield in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Gai-Cho Cauterizers are yaungol located at the Gai-Cho Battlefield in Townlong Steppes.
Gai-Cho Gatewatchers are yaungol located at the Gai-Cho Battlefield in Townlong Steppes.
Gao's Keg Tapper drops from Yan-Zhu the Uncasked in Stormstout Brewery.
Gan Darkcask is a pandaren found in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle. He seems to be speaking with Gao Longwagon.
Galenges is a flamewaker located at the Flamewake in Mount Hyjal.
Galkara the Assassin is an orc located at the Circle of Wills in the Underbelly.

Galakras is the fifth boss of Siege of Orgrimmar. It is Warlord Zaela's proto-drake and a descendant of Galakrond. The encounter involves splitting the raid into two groups: one that aides the faction leaders at the beach while the second takes the towers to bring down Galakras.
Gamon Will Save Us! is an achievement that is awarded for defeating General Nazgrim in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance while Gamon is alive and participating in the battle.
__NOTOC__ Galakrond Control Band drops from Galakras in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Gaja's War-Wolf is a wolf located at Lion's Landing in the Lion's Landing scenario.
Gal'dorak is a rare rhino found just to the east of Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
Galu Wellspring is a jinyu vendor found in the Timeless Isle.
Gai Lan Junior is a pandaren located at The Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Galzomar is one of three rotating rare demons that spawns at the Burning Front in Talador. The other two are Kharazos the Triumphant and Sikthiss, Maiden of Slaughter. They each drop the Burning Legion Missive (toy).

Gamon's Braid is a toy item that turns the player into Gamon, the (in)famous tauren from Orgrimmar, for 10 minutes. The transformation is accompanied by a voiced yell: : During combat, the player will randomly yell out various soundclips originally used by Gamon during the Siege of Orgrimmar, such as or .

The Gai-Cho are a tribe of yaungol raiders in Townlong Steppes that are locked in combat with the Krik'thik swarm of mantid from Kri'vess, as well as the Shado-Pan. They are allies of the nearby Osul tribe, having helped them with their push into Kun-Lai Summit at the Ox Gate. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, some Gai-Cho were found locked away in The Menagerie, led by Montak.
Galestriker Halanai is a draenei located at the Lunarfall in . Can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
The Gaiju Pearl was a drop from the Gaiju in Tanaan Jungle on the PTR for Patch 6.2.0, but the summoning event was cut before the patch went live.
__NOTOC__ Galthenos is a nathrezim located at the in Tanaan Jungle.

Gamescom (stylized as gamescom) is the world's largest gaming event and Europe's biggest for video games, held annually at the Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany. It is used by many video game developers to exhibit their upcoming games, including Blizzard Entertainment present nearly every year.
Gallywix's Garage is a sub-zone of Warspear's goblin district in Ashran.

The unnamed mother of Jastor Gallywix was a goblin pirate. She left her family when Jastor was very young in favor of a life of piracy. She tried to kill her own son twice. Nonetheless, Jastor had a painting commissioned in her likeness after her death and later hung it in his villa on Kezan.

Gakkiz Blusterblast is a goblin follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. He later traveled to the Wandering Isle as a member of the Order of the Broken Temple and is seen sitting with Xiang Grumblebelly in the Laughing Crane.
Gannon Forecastle is a forsaken located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

Gaiju was a Rare Elite beast located at the Scuttler's Coast in Tanaan Jungle. In order to summon the mob, two players were required in order to pilot the Yaeger-367. The vignette event was removed from the PTR before the release of patch 6.2.0.
